subtitle.message: Check your drone before its first flight.

loadFailed.message: Couldn't read the flight controller. Reconnect the USB cable and try again.

gyroLead.message: The gyroscope measures how fast the drone rotates. The flight controller uses this to keep it steady.

gyroTask.message: Pick up your drone and tilt it slowly. Watch the model follow your movements.

gyroWhy.message: When the drone starts to tip, the flight controller adjusts the motor speeds to correct it. The gyro measures the rotation so the controller can respond.

gyroHelp.message: Model not moving? Check the USB cable. If it still doesn't respond, ask a DroneTeam member.

alignLead.message: The DronoBox flight controller is mounted at 270° clockwise. Set this here so Betaflight reads its movements correctly.

alignLook.message: Find the white arrow on the flight controller and compare it with the arrow inside the frame.

alignCheck.message: To check it, go back to Gyroscope and tip the nose down. The model should follow.

alignUnknown.message: This firmware doesn't report the board direction here. Ask a DroneTeam member to check it.

alignFailed.message: Couldn't save the board direction. Ask a DroneTeam member for help.

alignWhy.message: The board direction tells Betaflight which movements are roll, pitch and yaw. Saving restarts the board; the app reconnects afterwards.

levelLead.message: Calibration sets the level position used by the flight controller.

levelTask.message: Place the drone on a flat table. Press Calibrate accelerometer and leave it still until calibration finishes.

levelWhy.message: In angle mode, the drone returns to level when you release the sticks. It uses the accelerometer to find that level position.

safetyLead.message: Remove all four propellers before testing the motors. Leave them off for the whole test: a spinning propeller can cut you.

safetyPropsOff.message: I checked: all four propellers are removed

safetyWatcher.message: A DroneTeam member is watching me

safetyBattery.message: Now plug in the battery. Leave the USB cable connected.

motorsLead.message: Test each motor and check its direction from above. Two should turn clockwise and two counter-clockwise.

motorsEnableHelp.message: Press any keyboard key to stop all motors.

motorsNoBattery.message: Connect the battery to power the motors. USB alone is not enough.

motorsQuestion.message: From above, which way did motor {{n}} turn?

motorsWrong.message: Motor {{n}} spins the wrong way. Unplug the battery, swap any two of the three wires between this motor and its ESC, plug the battery back in and test again.

motorsDone.message: All motors spin the right way

motorsWhy.message: Turning a propeller also twists the frame in the opposite direction. With two motors turning each way, those forces balance. To turn the drone, the controller speeds up one pair and slows the other.

radioLead.message: Switch on your transmitter, then move the sticks as shown below.

radioNoSignal.message: No radio signal. Check that the transmitter is on. Ask a DroneTeam member if it needs pairing.

radioThrottleHelp.message: Left stick up/down: more or less lift

radioPitchHelp.message: Right stick up/down: tilt the nose

radioAuxHelp.message: A switch, often used to arm the motors

radioTaskThrottleUp.message: Push the left stick all the way up

radioTaskThrottleDown.message: Pull the left stick all the way down

radioTaskYawLeft.message: Push the left stick to the left

radioTaskRollRight.message: Push the right stick to the right

radioWhy.message: The receiver sends stick positions as channel values, usually from 1000 to 2000 with 1500 in the centre. The flight controller uses them to adjust the motor speeds.

doneLead.message: Ask a DroneTeam member to check the drone and help you fly it.

doneProps.message: With the battery unplugged, fit each propeller to the matching motor direction

doneSticks.message: Keep the throttle down when arming

doneArming.message: Resolve these checks before arming. The connection warning clears when you disconnect from the app.

doneDisconnect.message: Press Disconnect. Unplug the battery, then the USB cable.

armingNO_GYRO.message: No gyro found. Ask a DroneTeam member.

armingFAILSAFE.message: Failsafe is active. Check the radio connection with a DroneTeam member.

armingRXLOSS.message: No radio signal. Is the transmitter on and bound?

armingTHROTTLE.message: The throttle stick isn't all the way down.

armingANGLE.message: The drone is tilted too far. Put it down flat.

armingBOOT_GRACE_TIME.message: The flight controller is starting up. Wait a few seconds.

armingCALIBRATING.message: The sensors are calibrating. Keep the drone still.

armingMSP.message: The app is connected. Disconnect before arming.

armingACC_CALIBRATION.message: Calibrate the accelerometer in the Level step.

armingMOTOR_PROTOCOL.message: No motor protocol is set. Ask a DroneTeam member.

armingREBOOT_REQUIRED.message: The flight controller needs a restart. Ask a DroneTeam member to help.

armingARM_SWITCH.message: Turn the arm switch off before trying again.

instructorText.message: Enter your PIN to open the full Betaflight settings. Return to workshop mode when finished.

instructorBaselineMissing.message: No saved kit settings are available. Ask the workshop organiser to add them.

instructorBaselineOk.message: Kit settings restored. The flight controller is restarting.

welcomeLead.message: Check the sensors, motor directions and radio before your first flight.

welcomeStep1Help.message: Connect the drone to your laptop with a micro-USB cable. Leave the battery unplugged.

welcomeStep2Help.message: Choose the device with STM32 or Betaflight in its name.

welcomeTrouble1.message: Try a USB cable that supports data. Charge-only cables will not work.

welcomeTrouble2.message: Try another USB port on the laptop.

welcomeTrouble3.message: Use Chrome or Edge for the USB connection.

welcomeTrouble4.message: Ask a DroneTeam member if it still does not appear.

welcomeFooter.message: Built by DroneTeam Twente on Betaflight, the open-source flight controller software (GPL-3.0).

meetLead.message: Select a part to see what it does.

partFrameFact.message: The PLA frame holds the parts together. Its four arms use a truss shape to keep them light and stiff.

partFcFact.message: The F4V3S flight controller runs Betaflight. It reads the sensors and adjusts each motor to keep the drone steady.

partPdbFact.message: The Matek power board distributes battery power to the four ESCs and supplies 5 V to the flight controller.

partEscFact.message: Each motor has a LittleBee 20 A ESC. It switches power through the motor's three wires to make it turn.

partMotorFact.message: The X2807 motor turns the propeller. Its 1300 KV rating means roughly 1300 rpm per volt with no load.

partPropFact.message: The 8-inch propellers push air down to lift the drone. Two turn clockwise and two counter-clockwise.

partReceiverFact.message: The RadioMaster RP2 receives the transmitter signal and passes your stick positions to the flight controller.

partBatteryFact.message: The 3S 2200 mAh LiPo powers the drone. Never puncture the battery or short-circuit its connector.

stillMoving.message: Movement detected. Set the drone down and let go.

stillTilted.message: The drone is tilted. Place it on a flat table.

escLead.message: Each motor has an electronic speed controller, or ESC.

escFact1.message: The flight controller sets the speed. The ESC switches power through the three motor wires to turn the rotor.

escFact2.message: Swapping any two motor wires reverses the direction. Disconnect the battery before changing wires.

escFact3.message: Find the ESC on the arm beside each motor.

sandboxLead.message: Choose a direction for each motor, then press Take off. This is a simulation; the real motors stay off.

sandbox_stable.message: It hovers. The clockwise pair balances the counter-clockwise pair; matching motors sit diagonally opposite each other.

sandbox_spinCw.message: The frame turns clockwise because more propellers turn counter-clockwise.

sandbox_spinCcw.message: The frame turns counter-clockwise because more propellers turn clockwise.

sandbox_unstable.message: It flips. The controller expects diagonal pairs, so this layout makes it correct the wrong motors.

stageFailed.message: The 3D view couldn't load. Reload the page to try again.

gameLead.message: Tilt your drone to match the outline, then hold still. Try all five positions.

gameMove.message: Match the outline with your drone.

axisIntro.message: Choose Roll, Pitch or Yaw to try it on the model.

exploreRoll.message: Roll tilts the drone sideways around its nose-to-tail axis.

explorePitch.message: Pitch tilts the nose up or down.

exploreYaw.message: Yaw turns the nose left or right while the drone stays level.

axisReference.message: The outline shows the level position.
